result.stdout:
Description:
  PostgreSQL database migration tool

Usage:
  db [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  init       Initialize a .mvdmio-migrations.yml configuration file in the current directory
  pull       Pull the database schema and save it as a schema.<env>.sql file
  cleanup    Pull schemas for all environments and delete obsolete migration files
  copy       Copy all table data from one environment's database to another (truncates destination tables).
  migration  Migration scaffolding commands
  migrate    Run database migrations

Description:
  Copy all table data from one environment's database to another (truncates destination tables).

Usage:
  db copy [options]

Options:
  -f, --from <from> (REQUIRED)       Source environment name (key in connectionStrings of .mvdmio-migrations.yml)
  -t, --to <to> (REQUIRED)           Destination environment name (key in connectionStrings of .mvdmio-migrations.yml)
  --schemas <schemas>                Override the schemas list from configuration. Comma-separated or repeated.
  --exclude-tables <exclude-tables>  Fully-qualified schema.table entries to skip. Comma-separated or repeated.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information

Description:
  Migrate the database to the latest version

Usage:
  db migrate latest [options]

Options:
  --connection-string <connection-string>                        Override the connection string from the configuration file
  -e, --environment <environment>                                The environment to use (looks up the connection string from connectionStrings in .mvdmio-migrations.yml)
  --phase <All|all|post-deploy|PostDeploy|pre-deploy|PreDeploy>  The deploy phase to run: pre-deploy, post-deploy, all (default: pre-deploy) [default: PreDeploy]
  -?, -h, --help                                                 Show help and usage information
